Al Jazeera live blog "Iran war live: US response to proposal under review after Qatar mediation" — published 30 September 2026

- Iran says it received a US response to Tehran's offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz as the country's senior leaders review Washington's counter-proposal.
- The Revolutionary Guard says "military conflict" continues daily in Hormuz as a maritime agency reports at least three commercial vessels have been hit by projectiles.
- Headline notes Trump claims war will end "very soon", provides no details.
- US official says "constructive" Iran talks continue but nuclear issues delay deal.
